title: Design, synthesis, and anticancer evaluation of a novel imine-linked covalent organic framework correlated to molecular docking and DFT insights.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究一种新型亚胺连接共价有机框架的合成及其抗癌活性，虽涉及分子对接和DFT计算，但对象为小分子-COF与拓扑异构酶而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: A new imine-linked covalent organic framework (COFTDTSC) was synthesized from terephthaldehyde and thiosemicarbazide under solvothermal conditions. The obtained material exhibited excellent chemical and thermal stability up to 625  degrees C, along with a high surface area of 1097.76 m(2) g(-1) and an average pore size of  approximately 1.18 nm. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) revealed an irregular, stone-like morphology distinct from the starting materials, confirming successful polymerization and framework formation. The anticancer potential of COFTDTSC was evaluated against three human cancer cell lines (HCT-116, HepG-2, and MCF-7), demonstrating notable cytotoxic activity with IC(50) values ranging from 10.28 to 18.04 microM, in comparison with the standard drugs doxorubicin and sorafenib. Molecular docking supported these results, revealing that COFTDTSC had the strongest binding affinity (-9.1 kcal mol(-1)) and stable interactions within human topoisomerase IIalpha, supported by multiple hydrogen bonding and hydrophobic interactions within the active site. Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations further examined the electronic structure and reactivity of the monomers and the COF. Polymerization into COFTDTSC reduced the energy gap and increased electronic softness, enhancing molecular reactivity. The COF exhibited delocalized charge density, a moderate dipole moment, and strong electron-acceptor properties, suggesting potential for biological interactions, such as DNA binding and enzyme inhibition. From a green chemistry perspective, the design of COFTDTSC integrates bioactive building blocks within a stable, porous organic framework, offering a promising platform for sustainable anticancer material development. These findings highlight COFTDTSC as a multifunctional candidate for future biomedical applications.
abstract_zh: 在溶剂热条件下，以对苯二甲醛和氨基硫脲为原料合成了一种新型亚胺键连接的共价有机框架（COFTDTSC）。所得材料表现出优异的化学和热稳定性，可耐受高达625摄氏度的温度，同时具有1097.76 m(2) g(-1)的高比表面积和约1.18 nm的平均孔径。扫描电子显微镜（SEM）显示其呈不规则的石状形貌，与起始原料不同，证实了聚合和框架形成的成功。COFTDTSC的抗癌潜力针对三种人类癌细胞系（HCT-116、HepG-2和MCF-7）进行了评估，显示出显著的细胞毒性活性，IC(50)值范围为10.28至18.04微摩尔，与标准药物多柔比星和索拉非尼相比。分子对接支持了这些结果，揭示COFTDTSC在人类拓扑异构酶IIα中具有最强的结合亲和力（-9.1 kcal mol(-1)）和稳定的相互作用，这由活性位点内的多个氢键和疏水相互作用所支持。密度泛函理论（DFT）计算进一步考察了单体和COF的电子结构和反应性。聚合为COFTDTSC降低了能隙并增加了电子柔软度，从而增强了分子反应性。该COF表现出离域的电荷密度、适中的偶极矩和强电子受体特性，暗示了其具有生物相互作用的潜力，如DNA结合和酶抑制。从绿色化学的角度来看，COFTDTSC的设计将生物活性构建块整合到稳定的多孔有机框架中，为可持续抗癌材料的开发提供了一个有前景的平台。这些发现突显了COFTDTSC作为未来生物医学应用的多功能候选材料。
